about: The epistola of the formulary “Mass of the Easter Vigil” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brethren: If you be risen with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is sitting at the right hand of God. Mind the things that are above, not the things that are upon the earth. For you are dead, and your life is hidden with Christ in God. When Christ shall appear, Who is your life, then you also shall appear with Him in glory.
